summary: Beast Sense is always prepared, cast with the ability this feat raised; once per Long Rest cast it without a slot. Advantage on checks to influence Beasts.

benefits.name: Benefits
benefits.summary: Beast Sense is always prepared, cast with the ability this feat raised; once per Long Rest cast it without a slot. Advantage on checks to influence Beasts.
benefits.text: You always have Beast Sense prepared; it uses the ability this feat increased. You can cast it once without a spell slot or Concentration, regaining that on a Long Rest, and with your slots as usual. You also have Advantage on Charisma checks to influence Beasts (played at the table: the game has no influence checks yet).
